newsitem.title: SPAIN: Banco Popular signs deal with Peru group.
newsitem.headline: Banco Popular signs deal with Peru group.

text.p: Spain's Banco Popular said on Thursday it had signed an agreement with Banco de Credito del Peru, the leading Peruvian bank, to provide clients with products and services from both banks.
"The accord...expands the possibilities of Popular's clientele for access to Latin America," Popular said in a statement.

The group already has agreements in Chile, through Banco Credito Inversiones; in Venezuela, through Banco Exterior de Venezuela; and the recently signed deal in Puerto Rico with Banco Popular de Puerto Rico.
